text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A stellar lineup of rivals gathered for 
the Takarazuka Kinen. Taking in every 
single one of them, Hishi Miracle—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shrimp, squid, scallops, snow crab. 
Comparing them to the ingredients of an 
all-inclusive okonomiyaki. She heads to 
the track to devour them all in one go.
